Title: General availability: Power BI Embedded in Microsoft Azure Government Cloud

Body.Content:
Power BI Embedded is now generally available in Microsoft Azure Government.

 

Power BI Embedded enables ISVs and developers to embed stunning, fully interactive visuals and analytics into their applications. For more details, visit the Power BI Embedded page.
